objective: Test an FCOS-style LTRB box contract with multi-cell box/class supervision while preserving the lightweight MAX-native graph.

attempts.change: Keep box/class supervision on neighboring cells but reserve peak objectness for the Gaussian center.

verdict.reason: The new box contract reduced duplicate objectness peaks but did not improve held-out detection F1. Further hand-designed target tuning is not justified.

notes: At a diagnostic 0.01 threshold, localization recall was 0.963 for pear, 0.750 for apple, and 0.828 for banana, confirming that confidence calibration and classification were larger problems than coarse localization.
No experimental checkpoint was connected to autonomous motion.
